step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture illustrates an automated training environment setup for IHS Markit's Kingdom application using AWS services. 1. An instructor (User) triggers a CloudFormation template deployment. 2. CloudFormation provisions the RDS database (SQL Express) and FSx storage, and invokes a custom resource backed by a Lambda function. 3. Lambda invokes Systems Manager to execute scripts on an EC2 license server. 4. The EC2 instance configures the AppStream image builder, modifying session scripts so that FSx is mounted during streaming sessions. 5. EC2 sends a completion signal back to CloudFormation's wait condition. 6. Once provisioned, AppStream Users connect to AppStream via a web browser streaming URL, accessing Kingdom backed by FSx and RDS.
